summary: Seventeen-year-old female from Colorado Springs fell on snow and hit rocks while backcountry skiing on Skyscraper Glacier, sustaining serious injuries. Ground teams from Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and Grand County Search and Rescue went in on foot from Rollins Pass; rescuers stabilized her in a litter and used a technical rope system to raise her ~160 ft up the glacier to a landing zone at ~12,000 ft on the Continental Divide; Flight For Life Colorado transported her to a Denver-area hospital with non-life-threatening injuries; rescue lasted ~7 hours.
location: Skyscraper Glacier, Indian Peaks Wilderness (south of Devils Thumb Pass, north of Rollins Pass)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Grand County Search and Rescue; Flight For Life Colorado; Boulder County Sheriff Office; Nederland Fire; Timberline Fire; American Medical Response; Colorado Army National Guard
notes: Glacier sits on the Continental Divide (Boulder/Grand county line); Boulder County Communications received the 11:08 a.m. call; Grand County SAR assisted RMRG.
